options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Shuffle Historia Crux
options.doc: Allow randomization of the Historia Crux (entrance rando)
options.doc_fr: Autoriser la randomisation de l'Historia Crux (entrée rando)

options.name: Allow DLC Items
options.doc: Allow DLC items in the pool (requires additional DLC Restoration mod)
options.doc_fr: Autoriser les éléments DLC dans le pool (exige un module de restauration DLC supplémentaire)

options.name: Fully Remote Items
options.doc: Have Archipelago handle excluded locations instead of filling them locally.
options.doc_fr: Demandez à Archipel de gérer les endroits exclus au lieu de les remplir localement.

options.name: Allow DLC Locations
options.doc: Allow DLC locations to be in scope for Crux randomisation
options.doc_fr: Permettre aux emplacements DLC d'être dans la portée de la randomisation Crux

options.name: Crux fixed start
options.doc:
When using Shuffle Historia Crux, whether or not the starting location(s) should
be fixed to be:
- 0: None
- 1: Bodhum 3AF
- 2: Bodhum 3AF -> Bresha 5AF

Note that when Allow DLC Locations is also enabled, the 3 DLC locations will be
randomised and connected to the initial location even if it is fixed here.
This option is recommended if not using enemy/boss randomisation at the point of
converting the AP generated seed data into the rando modpack.

options.name: Win Condition
options.doc:
In addition to reaching the end of Academia 500AF, extra conditions can be placed
which will prevent you from accessing the final bosses until they are completed.
- 0: No additional checks
- 1: Fragment Hunt - A minimum number of fragments will be required

options.name: Fragment Hunt Count
options.doc:
If the win condition is set to "Fragment Count" this controls how many fragments are required

NOTE: Currently game logic does not take this into account at all, so UT may falsely report
"Go Mode" when you do not have enough fragments. Until more (or at least most) of them are in
the pool this will likely not be resolved. Sorry :)

options.name: Require Final Bosses for victory
options.doc:
If disabled, victory will be granted once whatever win condition check is cleared at the end of
Academia 500AF.
If enabled, the final bosses must be defeated to win the seed.
options.doc_fr:
En cas de handicap, la victoire sera accordée une fois que le contrôle de la condition de victoire sera terminé à Academia 500AF.
Si elle est activée, les patrons finaux doivent être vaincus pour gagner la semence.
